source.ground: NRCan HRDEM mosaic 1 m DTM (https://canelevation-dem.s3.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/hrdem-mosaic-1m/8_2-mosaic-1m-dtm.tif), Open Government Licence - Canada; fallback AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium) where HRDEM is nodata
source.classes: OpenStreetMap way tags tunnel/bridge/layer on relation 102388 (ODbL)

maxGradePct.basis: documented: steepest Line 1 grade is 4% north of Summerhill (nycsubway.org, TTC Yonge-University-Spadina Subway)

tysseBoredRailDepth.basis: TYSSE twin bores: invert 20-30 m below surface (Tunnel Business Magazine, Dec 2013); rail ~1 m above a 25 m invert = ESTIMATE within that range

tysseStationRailDepth.basis: ESTIMATE (TYSSE station boxes are cut-and-cover; depth not found yet)

boreInternalDiameter.basis: documented: TYSSE bored tunnels 5.4 m internal diameter, 6.1 m bore (TBM magazine 2013; TAC 2012 paper)

yonge1954BoxRailDepth.basis: 1954 Yonge cut-and-cover excavated to final grade 30-40 ft (9.1-12.2 m) below street (Proc. ICE 1954 / NRC strain-measurement paper); 9.5 m = ESTIMATE within range

universityBoredRailDepth.basis: ESTIMATE: Queen's Park and St. Patrick are in bored tunnels (Wikipedia, Line 1 Yonge-University); depth not found yet

otherBoxRailDepth.basis: ESTIMATE: other cut-and-cover box sections (1963 University, 1973-74 North Yonge, 1978 Spadina, 1996 Sheppard West)

boxHeightAboveRail.basis: ESTIMATE: rail top to box roof (inside)

portalCover.basis: ESTIMATE: soil/structure over the roof at a portal face

rosedaleCutDepth.basis: Rosedale is an open-cut station (Wikipedia infobox); depth ESTIMATE

verticalCurveRadius.basis: ESTIMATE: minimum vertical curve radius (m) used to round grade changes
